name: season-ramp-uk-spring
description: Rest-season weight at about 55 N (UK) on 2027-03-16: halfway down the spring ramp, 0.5.
why: 16 March 2027 is 75 days after 31 December 2026 (31 + 28 + 16): weight = 1 - (75 - 60) / 30 = 0.5. The ramp runs on both sides of the full rest ('and back'). Hand computation.
